=== ROOT CancerOS breast cancer digital twin ===
 Research-only, time-indexed, provenance-aware breast cancer imaging, simulation and interpretation prototype. NOT validated clinical decision support. 
Sources: PRD
  --> HAS_DOMAIN D.DATA Clinical research data
  --> HAS_DOMAIN D.IMG Medical imaging
  --> HAS_DOMAIN D.TWIN Digital twin
  --> HAS_DOMAIN D.SIM Synthetic longitudinal engine
  --> HAS_DOMAIN D.AI Multimodal intelligence
  --> HAS_DOMAIN D.UX Researcher experience
  --> HAS_DOMAIN D.EVAL Scientific evaluation
  --> HAS_DOMAIN D.INFRA Platform infrastructure
  --> HAS_DOMAIN D.GOV Safety and provenance
  --> EXCLUDES X.WHOLE Whole-body digital twin
  --> EXCLUDES X.MULTI Multiple cancers
  --> EXCLUDES X.CARE Clinical diagnosis/prescription
  --> EXCLUDES X.SURV Validated prognosis/survival prediction
  --> EXCLUDES X.GENOME Whole-genome/cell-scale simulation
  --> EXCLUDES X.HOSP Production EHR/hospital integrations
  --> EXCLUDES X.DRUG Drug discovery or causal therapy optimization
  --> EXCLUDES X.PHOTOMRI Synthetic follow-up scans represented as authentic MRI
  --> REFERENCES REF.MAMA MAMA-MIA
  --> REFERENCES REF.NNUNET nnU-Net
  --> REFERENCES REF.SLICER 3D Slicer
  --> REFERENCES REF.OHIF OHIF/Cornerstone3D
  --> REFERENCES REF.MONAI MONAI
  --> REFERENCES REF.IDC IDC Index
  --> REFERENCES REF.DCMQI dcmqi
  --> REFERENCES REF.LIT Textbook and clinical standards
  --> HAS_WORKFLOW WF.REAL Real imaging vertical slice
  --> HAS_WORKFLOW WF.SIM Synthetic scenario vertical slice
  --> HAS_WORKFLOW WF.NEW Add observation
  --> HAS_WORKFLOW WF.AI Evidence linked interpretation
  --> HAS_WORKFLOW WF.REALVAL Actual longitudinal evaluation
  --> HAS_WORKFLOW WF.RELEASE Demo readiness

 Authentic patient, imaging and clinical evidence, normalized but source-preserving. 
Sources: PRD,ARCH

  --> OWNS DATA.SOURCE Dataset and licensing registry
  --> OWNS DATA.PATIENT ResearchPatient
  --> OWNS DATA.DIAGNOSIS CancerDiagnosis

  --> OWNS DATA.PROV ProvenanceRecord
  --> OWNS DATA.BRANCH SimulationBranch
  --> OWNS DATA.RUN SimulationRun
  --> OWNS DATA.ARTIFACT Artifact

=== D.SIM Synthetic longitudinal engine ===
 Five hypothetical trajectories with treatment events, clinical values and uncertainty. 
Sources: PRD,ARCH
  <-- HAS_DOMAIN ROOT CancerOS breast cancer digital twin
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.ELIG Treatment and scenario eligibility
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.RESPONSE Family 1: strong response
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.STABLE Family 2: partial/stable
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.PROGRESS Family 3: progression
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.REGROW Family 4: response then regrowth
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.TOXIC Family 5: clinical deterioration
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.EXPOSURE Treatment exposures
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.LATENT Latent evolution state
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.OBS Observation simulation
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.SEED Reproducibility
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.VALID Simulation validation
  --> IMPLEMENTS SIM.BATCH Cohort branching target

=== DATA.VISIT ClinicalVisit ===
 Clinical encounter with timestamp and links to observations; do not conflate visit and scan. 
Sources: DATA,API
  <-- OWNS D.DATA Clinical research data
  <-- RELATES_TO DATA.PATIENT ResearchPatient
  --> RELATES_TO DATA.LABS LaboratoryResult
  --> RELATES_TO DATA.VITAL VitalSign
  --> RELATES_TO DATA.SYMPTOM SymptomObservation
  --> RELATES_TO DATA.NOTE ClinicalNote
  <-- HAS_STEP WF.NEW Add observation
  <-- WORKFLOW_PRECEDES UX.IMPORT New observation workflow
  --> WORKFLOW_PRECEDES TWIN.HISTORY Append-only historical updates

=== DATA.NOTE ClinicalNote ===
 Source text or synthetic note with context, negation and evidence spans. 
Sources: DATA,API
  <-- OWNS D.DATA Clinical research data
  <-- RELATES_TO DATA.VISIT ClinicalVisit

=== TWIN.STATE Time-indexed state ===
 State binds patient, timestamp, geometry, clinical observations, treatment events, quality, missingness and provenance. 
Sources: PRD,IMG,SIM
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.TWIN Digital twin
  <-- CONSTRAINS GOV.PROV Five provenance classes

=== TWIN.COMPARE Change analysis ===
 Compare appropriate lesion and clinical values with units, comparability and uncertainty. 
Sources: PRD,IMG,SIM
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.TWIN Digital twin
  <-- HAS_STEP WF.NEW Add observation
  <-- WORKFLOW_PRECEDES TWIN.HISTORY Append-only historical updates
  --> WORKFLOW_PRECEDES AI.FEAT Deterministic multimodal features

=== SIM.TOXIC Family 5: clinical deterioration ===
 Potential worsening labs/symptoms independent of tumor burden, not proven drug causality. 
Sources: SIM,DATA
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.SIM Synthetic longitudinal engine
  <-- GUARDS SIM.ELIG Treatment and scenario eligibility
  --> PRODUCES TWIN.BRANCH Scenario branch isolation
  <-- CONSTRAINS GOV.CTCAE Adverse-event grading boundary

=== SIM.LATENT Latent evolution state ===
 Simulated underlying tumor burden and clinical condition separated from noisy measurement generator. 
Sources: SIM,DATA
  <-- IMPLEMENTS D.SIM Synthetic longitudinal engine
  <-- HAS_STEP WF.SIM Synthetic scenario vertical slice
  <-- WORKFLOW_PRECEDES SIM.ELIG Treatment and scenario eligibility
  --> WORKFLOW_PRECEDES SIM.OBS Observation simulation

=== AI.NLP Clinical note extraction ===
 Extract typed, supported facts with date, negation, certainty and source span. 
Sources: AI,SAF

  --> PRECEDES AI.FUSE Late multimodal fusion
  <-- HAS_STEP WF.AI Evidence linked interpretation
  --> WORKFLOW_PRECEDES AI.FEAT Deterministic multimodal features
  <-- CONSTRAINS GOV.PRIV Privacy and access

 Versioned source-linked relationships among observed patient entities and curated medical concepts. 
Sources: AI,SAF

 Synchronize 3D, clinical charts, date, treatment markers and state provenance.
